name: Entombed Spirit
disable: DC 17 Occultism check (trained) to weaken the spirit, DC 18 Athletics check (trained) to force the spirit's face back inside the wall, or DC 19 Diplomacy check (trained) to talk down the spirit; two total successes across all skills are required to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area and resets immediately thereafter. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed if the remains of the deceased are removed from the wall.
routine: (3 actions) The spirit attempts to Grapple up to two creatures within 10 feet with a +14 Athletics modifier, then squeezes each creature it has Grabbed, dealing 1d10+4 untyped damage. The haunt doesn't apply a multiple attack penalty to the second attempt to Grapple.

items.name: Gasp
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the wall where the corpse is entombed

---

Effect The spirit gasps and wails for aid while the wall takes on the shape of its face and roils, growing tendrils. All creatures within 10 feet must succeed at a DC 18 Will save save or be Frightened 1 for as long as the haunt remains active. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: The wall bulges out in the shape of a howling humanoid face as it twists and forms tendrils reaching for nearby creatures. This haunt is formed when a murder victim is entombed within a wall before or after their death.
